snippet.title: Backrooms: Reminiscence - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the game on October 31st!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3919010/Backrooms_Reminiscence/

In Backrooms: Reminiscence, you start your first day at NovaSync Research Institute. Your task of the day is to see the ongoing development of the second Outpost. You're expecting to meet some people in the second Outpost, but no one seems to be there. Something unexpected happens, and now you're left alone wandering the infinite hallways of The Backrooms.

Coming out on October 31st.

//
